name: Navalpino (Spain)
description: Divided by a broad white diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navalpino (a pine, a tree stump and a bird).
history: Municipal flag of Navalpino; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
Navalpino arms — pine, stump and bird
